lb-q2d7.title: Establish validated drag-based locomotion
lb-q2d7.description: Goal: make BioLife locomotion demonstrably correct under a coherent drag model. Context: src/physics.ts currently contains rotational anti-damping and unverified timestep/order behavior; the wiki records the agreed constraints. Requirements: establish deterministic headless validation, a canonical breaststroke swimmer, and only then reconnect evolvable gait parameters. Acceptance: passive and reciprocal negative controls pass, the canonical swimmer advances repeatably with bounded drift/yaw and timestep convergence, and locomotion can later be inherited. Out of scope: unrelated ecosystem balance, mating, rendering, and collision changes.
